title: Living on Snipe Street in Lake Vista near Sharky
summary: Jones says he lived on Snipe Street in Lake Vista, where streets have bird names, and Sharky lived not far away.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Where did you live in Lake Vista? I lived on Snipe Street. And Sharky wasn't far?
No, he wasn't that far away. I'm trying to think of anything. I don't know if it was Thrusher or some street like that he lived on.
They were alphabetical, I still are a judge, on those streets. Birds names. Birds names, were they alphabetical?
